mentions.name: Roadside Stand Discovery & Checkout App
mentions.description: A free discovery and checkout platform for roadside stands selling produce, honey, maple syrup, eggs, firewood, crafts, and similar goods. Vendors sign up for free, list up to three stands with their products, and state accepted payment methods (Venmo, CashApp, PayPal, Apple Cash, Zelle, or cash). Users discover stands by list, search, or map, view ratings and details, then scan a QR code at the stand to open a web cart and check out via the vendor's payment methods — the app standardizes the checkout experience but does not process payments, since stands remain self-serve on the honor system. Buyers receive a receipt, vendors get sale-intent alerts, users can report out-of-stock items and receive restock alerts, and they can favorite, share, rate stands, and curate shareable collections. Planned features include basic reporting, light inventory management, and support for farmers markets, craft fairs, and Christmas markets. It is web-first (Supabase with a Svelte front end), with an iOS app mostly built and an Android app planned to follow shortly.
mentions.problem: Producers and sellers of roadside goods put a lot of hard work into the process and deserve a legit discovery tool and a basic stand management system that does not make them change their process or get in their way.
mentions.audience: Any roadside vendor with a home business (produce, honey, maple syrup, eggs, firewood, crafts, etc.) and users who want to discover stands near them.
